تغصوا (form I)
# تَغُصُّوا (taḡuṣṣū) /ta.ɣusˤ.sˤuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of غَصَّ (ḡaṣṣa)
# تُغَصُّوا (tuḡaṣṣū) /tu.ɣasˤ.sˤuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of غَصَّ (ḡaṣṣa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
